decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [ST_25_180SUTTONCOURT_00, Fire Safety Strategy received 21/07/2025
ST_25_180SUTTONCOURT_01 Rev E, ST_25_180SUTTONCOURT_02 Rev E, ST_25_180SUTTONCOURT_03 Rev F, ST_25_180SUTTONCOURT_04 Rev F, ST_25_180SUTTONCOURT_05 Rev F, ST_25_180SUTTONCOURT_06 Rev G
Received 21/01/2026 
].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the [insert] elevation shall be obscure-glazed and non-opening below 1.7 metres above internal floor level. The windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than in accordance with the requirements of this condition. 
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy

Condition : 5 - The window(s) to be fitted on the [front/rear] roof face of the dwelling shall be black-framed and traditional, conservation-style.
Reason: In order to safeguard the architectural and historic interest of the [conservation area/listed building].
description: Erection of a rear roof extension with Juliet balcony, and one front roof window, a side roof extension with one front and one rear roof window. Erection of a part first floor rear extension. Replacement of front porch and replacement of all the existing windows to aluminium. Installation of external insulation on the front upper and side elevations. Installation of a front boundary wall compromising an increase in height of the gate, wall and railings. Replacement of roof tiles to match existing.
